question: Q-W-M2-D4
text: Which 10 stock items had the lowest closing stock at any calendar month end in 2015, and at which month end?
interpretation: The 10 stock items with the lowest closing stock at any calendar month end of 2015: each item's minimum month-end closing units and the first month end at which it occurred (ties: units, then item id).
assemble: WITH e AS (SELECT wwi_stock_item_id, closing_date AS d_star, closing_units, balance_basis FROM month_ends WHERE snap_rows > 0), item_min AS (SELECT wwi_stock_item_id, MIN(closing_units) AS min_closing_units FROM e GROUP BY wwi_stock_item_id), first_at_min AS (SELECT m.wwi_stock_item_id, m.min_closing_units, MIN(e.d_star) AS month_end_date, MAX(e.balance_basis) AS balance_basis FROM item_min m JOIN e ON e.wwi_stock_item_id = m.wwi_stock_item_id AND e.closing_units = m.min_closing_units GROUP BY m.wwi_stock_item_id, m.min_closing_units), ranked AS (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.min_closing_units, f.wwi_stock_item_id) AS rank_no FROM first_at_min f) SELECT r.rank_no, r.wwi_stock_item_id, n.stock_item, r.min_closing_units, r.month_end_date, r.balance_basis FROM ranked r JOIN names n ON n.wwi_stock_item_id = r.wwi_stock_item_id WHERE r.rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY r.rank_no
note: Tableau returns each item's closing stock per month end (semi-additive measure); selecting each item's minimum month and ranking happens in assembly.
